difficulty_reason: Prove Hilbfunctor^d_{X/S} is limit preserving when X -> S is of finite presentation: for T = lim T_i affine over S and Z in Hilb^d(T), the morphism Z -> T is of finite presentation, so limits-lemma-descend-finite-presentation gives Z_i of finite presentation over some T_i mapping to X_{T_i} and pulling back to Z; limits-lemma-descend-closed-immersion-finite-presentation upgrades Z_i -> X_{T_i} to a closed immersion after increasing i; limits-lemma-descend-finite-locally-free makes Z_i -> T_i finite locally free of degree d after increasing i; then Z_i is a point of Hilb^d(T_i).
